CITIZENS’ ADVISORY COMMISSION ON DISABILITIES AGENDA

  Special Meeting

  Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities In-Person Meeting

  Members Of The Public Have The Option To Submit Online Public Comments Or Email
  Comments To Jennifer.Kumiyama@longbeach.gov

  Comments May Also Be Provided In The Zoom Meeting Using The Raise Hand Function

  Please Dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 981 6445 6257
  Passcode: 116311
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98164456257

  Please Note The Zoom Meeting May Encounter Technical Disruptions, But In-Person Access
  And Public Comment Will Continue To Be Available In Accordance With The Brown Act

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-57317  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens’ Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, December 11, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-57318  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-57319  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the City Manager’s Office about
  the LA 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Jennifer Kumiyama at (562) 570-6257
or jennifer.kumiyama@longbeach.gov.
